# Sensory Quantity

The scalar numeric result of a sensory observation — a value with unit, determinacy, and granularity. Equivalent to gmeow:ScalarQuantity (following the #77 alias precedent); the name 'SensoryQuantity' is the domain-specific label for the same construct in the sensor/observation stack.
